<!-- pr-reviewer: b372d6c75d9e4276b2635d5d24ced80e2ac541d6 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** Safety-tier review (posted motion). #1600 is already merged, so this is one commit (b372d6c7) on main and is not stacked. A trial merge with current main (b08d7397) is clean.

### What looks good
- `assets/posts/tormach.cps:441` adds `liftZ()` right after `G43 H..` in `startPreamble`. The tool-change sequence is now `G53 G0 Z<safe>`, `G30`, `T.. M6`, `G43 H..`, `G53 G0 Z<safe>`, then the spindle start and the first X/Y or A move. `liftZ` goes through `safeZ()`, so a machine that states a safe Z (#495) gets that Z, and a refused machine writes nothing (the refusal by name is already issued).
- **Order is right.** `G53` is a machine-coordinate move, so the `G43` just applied does not shift it. Nothing between `M6` and `G43` moves the machine (`G43` itself does not move on LinuxCNC). The lift is the first thing after `G43`, so it comes before `S.. M3`, the probe's `M5`, coolant, the `xyFirst` `G0 X Y`, a drill cycle's R-plane approach and the 4th-axis notes and index. Thread-mill and drill sections use the same preamble.
- **4th axis:** in `index_4face_microarc4.nc` the order is `G43 H3`, `G53 G0 Z0`, `S6000 M3`, `M8`, the A notes, `G53 G0 Z0`, `G0 A..`. A moves only after the lift. The second lift is redundant and harmless, as the decision file says.
- The G30 is kept, the program end (#1600) is unchanged, and the decision file `docs/decisions/1596-toolchange-lift.md` records the reasoning and the dropped options.

### Golden diff (scripted)
- `git diff -U0 -- '*.nc'` across 33 files gives **+35 / -0**. Every added line is `G53 G0 Z0`.
- A structural check over **every** `.nc` golden in the tree that has a `T.. M6` and a `G30` (33 files, 35 tool changes, the first tool change of each program included): every tool change has `G43` followed by `G53 G0 Z<n>` before any X, Y or A word, `G30` or `M3`. **No tool change is missing a lift.**
- No lathe, plasma or other-post golden changed, and no snapshot PNGs were touched.

### Local results (macOS, debug, merged with main b08d7397)
| Run | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-post` (all 48 binaries incl. `script_tormach`, `probe_spindle_stop`, `probe_tormach`, `ream_cycle`, `script_tormach_lathe`, `script_tormach_plasma`) | all ok |
| app `tormach_toolchange_lift` | 3 passed |
| app `tormach_safe_retract` / `tormach_program_end` / `tormach_post` / `tormach_fourth_axis` / `tormach_end_units` / `tormach_machines` / `tormach_lathes` | 4 / 3 / 10 / 12 / 7 / 6 / 2 passed |
| app golden users: `conformance` / `golden_cl` / `solid_law_goldens` / `program_units` / `recorded_post_streams` / `microarc_test_part` / `probe_op` / `post_cycle_feed_spindle` / `plasma_post` / `plasma_post_refusals` / `tinyg_post` / `program_comments` / `program_entry` / `posting` / `lathe_post_tormach` | 7 / 32 / 7 / 7 / 5 / 2 / 12 / 8 / 5 / 7 / 18 / 4 / 9 / 17 / 8 passed |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets --no-deps -- -D warnings` | clean |

### Mutation check (each applied to `tormach.cps`, run, then restored; the tree is clean afterwards)
| Mutation | `tormach_toolchange_lift` | `tormach_safe_retract` | `tormach_program_end` |
|---|---|---|---|
| Drop the lift | 3/3 red | 1 red | green |
| Move the lift to after the section's first `G0 X Y` | 3/3 red | 1 red | green |
| Hard-code `G53 G0 Z0` (ignore the stated safe Z) | 1 red (`a_stated_safe_z…`) | 2 red | green |
| Skip the lift on the program's first tool change | 3/3 red | 1 red | green |

Dropping the lift also turns `script_tormach` (post goldens, 7 red) and `microarc_test_part` red. The pins bite.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Questions / notes (not blocking)
1. **Lathe and plasma: I agree with the reasoning.** Plasma's G30 height is its traverse height. On the lathe there is no "up". As for #1604: the first rapid runs from G30 to the generator's start point, which sits outside the stock diameter (the `turning_mm.nc` start is X14.2 on Ø12 stock). A straight line from a G30 spot outside the stock's diameter therefore stays at or above the larger of the two X values, and never goes left of the start Z, so it cannot cross the stock or reach the chuck. A crossing needs G30 stored inside the stock diameter in front of the face. That is not a workable tool-change spot on a turret or gang-plate Tormach lathe, because the index or the other tools would hit the part. **P3 is right**, with the issue's own trigger to raise it if a Hub or machine run shows otherwise.
2. The bare `G30` move itself still goes X, Y and Z together from the top of travel down to the stored G30 Z. That is PathPilot's convention and the operator's preset tool-change spot, so it is outside this fix. It is only mentioned because the lift now makes the stored G30 Z harmless after the change, but not on the way to it.
3. Small point in `crates/app/tests/tormach_toolchange_lift.rs:105-106`: `assert!(next.is_some())` only shows that the section moves sideways at all, not that it does so after the lift. The ordering is really pinned by `lifts_after_tool_changes` (the lift must be the line right after `G43`) and by the G30-to-sideways loop below it, so coverage holds.
4. Housekeeping is fine: `PROCESS_VERSION` is untouched (no process files changed), there is a decision file, the `Changelog:` line notes the posted-output change, the body ends `Fixes #1596`, and the commit subject is conventional.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Safety-tier review (this changes posted G-code).

**What looks good**
- `assets/posts/tormach.cps` `startPreamble`: one added `liftZ()` right after `G43 H..`, before the spindle start, coolant and any A, X or Y move. It writes `G53 G0 Z<safe>`: machine coordinates, non-modal, so the `G43` just applied does not shift it. It is Z0 by default, or the machine's stated safe Z scaled through `fu()`.
- Block order everywhere: `G53 G0 Z0`, `G30`, `T.. M6`, `G43 H..`, `G53 G0 Z0`, then spindle and coolant, then (if indexed) `G53 G0 Z0` and `G0 A..`, then the first X/Y. Checked in the microARC golden (lift before `G0 A0` and the first X/Y; the second lift is the documented harmless duplicate) and in the probe goldens (T99: lift before the probe `M5` and the first `G0 X Y`). The first tool change of a program takes the same path as later ones.
- Goldens: 35 added lines, all `G53 G0 Z0`, none removed, each one a single insertion straight after a `G43 Hn`. No lathe, plasma or snapshot PNG file changed. The tester-kit `.nc` changes only by that line.
- Tests: `tormach_safe_retract` counts 3 to 5 (matches two tool changes plus the end), `probe_spindle_stop` skips `G53` lines when finding the first work move (the probe `M5`-before-motion check still stands), and the three new pins in `tormach_toolchange_lift.rs`. The decision file `docs/decisions/1596-toolchange-lift.md`, the `Changelog:` line and `Fixes #1596` are present. No process file, `CHANGELOG.md` or `PROCESS_VERSION` is touched.
- Words used (`G53`, `G0`, `G30`, `G43`, `M6`) are RS-274 / LinuxCNC; no other product's material.

**Results merged with main** (on the self-hosted runner: https://github.com/NeoTech/Camcraft/actions/runs/43538309190, trial merge with main 745edc36, conclusion success)
- Quick gate: post suites ok, app suites ok, 0 failed.
- Clippy `-p camcraft-app -p camcraft-post --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Not run locally: the diff has no `cfg(windows)` or per-OS pinned value, so no Windows-only reading is owed.

**What the hand check covers, and what it does not**
mkinney's comment (01:18Z, PathPilot Hub 770MX sim v2.14.4) records a user run of a hand-written program `E_toolchange_lift_1606.nc` (`G30`, `T2 M6`, `G43 H2`, `G53 G0 Z0`, `G0 X0 Y0`). With the stored G30 low (G54 Z 3.1644 against 4.7255 at the top of travel), the `G53 G0 Z0` after `G43` lifted to the top before the X/Y rapid, and the program ended at the top of Z. That confirms, on a simulated control, that the word sequence the post now writes behaves as intended. It does not cover:
- output posted by CamCraft: the program was hand-written, not posted by this build; the posted order is proved by the goldens and pins above;
- a real machine (a sim, not a spindle);
- an indexed (A) section, a probe section, inch output, a machine-stated safe Z other than 0, or an ATC changer;
- the move into the G30 spot (below).

**Requested before merge**
None.

**Notes (not blocking)**
1. Already in place, not changed here: a bare `G30` moves X, Y and Z together to the stored G30 position, so the move into the G30 spot is not Z-first-then-XY. This PR makes the exit from it safe; the entry stays with the operator's stored position. A follow-up issue may be worth filing (#1604 is lathe-only).
2. `liftZ()` runs `safeZ()` again after `retract()`. On a non-Tormach machine that states no safe Z, check that the "does not state its safe Z" message is not emitted twice. No test here pins it either way.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
